initial_scope: Shorter knife, flat rest, bounded reachable placement/yaw region from curriculum_split_v01.json; no full-board/any-knife claim
validation_gate: Physical success on the three frozen validation placements, with original contact/speed/load and three-second unsupported-hold checks. Offline loss alone is insufficient.
test_gate: Only after validation: evaluate all eight untouched test placements. Report numerator/denominator and interval; require at least 7/8 successes and no blade-contact/load-stop violation for this limited curriculum.
vision_check: Repeat validation with blank images and compare actual pickup and action dependence; if vision has no demonstrated effect, do not claim camera-driven placement generalization.
geometry: Two prepared held-out assets are excluded from first-student training. Fresh physical teacher and student tests needed before any geometry-generalization claim.
rest_pose: Current flat-rest-only curriculum does not qualify other resting poses.
original_setup: All mutations confined to v32 and checklist status; preserve earlier models and evidence.
